meta.scope: Vietnam Batch 13 — Further provincial densification outside the main growth poles (Hanoi, HCMC, Bac Ninh, Hai Phong, Dong Nai). Adds Da Nang, Can Tho, Central Highlands framing, and selected secondary provinces.

candidates.title: Da Nang Gross Regional Domestic Product
candidates.publisher: General Statistics Office / local statistical office
candidates.description: Official GRDP for Da Nang — the principal urban and services/tourism hub of the Central region. Regularly ranks among the mid-to-upper tier of provincial economies and contributes meaningfully to national growth.
candidates.notes: Primary Central urban-core regional output node.

candidates.title: Can Tho Gross Regional Domestic Product
candidates.publisher: General Statistics Office / local statistical office
candidates.description: Official GRDP for Can Tho — the largest city and commercial hub of the Mekong Delta. Complements the broader Mekong Delta agricultural and aquaculture profile with an urban services and logistics node.
candidates.notes: Primary Mekong Delta urban-core regional output node.

candidates.title: Central Highlands regional economic profile
candidates.publisher: Derived from GSO regional and provincial series
candidates.description: System-level view of the Central Highlands — a major coffee, pepper and agricultural region with significant ethnic-minority populations and distinct development challenges and opportunities relative to the coastal and delta growth poles.
candidates.notes: Central Highlands spatial densification that links agriculture, ethnicity and lagging-region dynamics.

candidates.title: Selected secondary provincial economies (Quang Ninh, Thanh Hoa, Nghe An, etc.)
candidates.description: Grouping of secondary but still material provincial economies outside the top industrial and dual-core set — including Quang Ninh, Thanh Hoa, Nghe An and similar mid-tier contributors that collectively add meaningful shares of national growth and diversify the spatial structure.
candidates.notes: Secondary provincial densification that softens the exclusive focus on the top five growth poles.

candidates.title: Vietnam further-provincial densification meta-node
candidates.publisher: Derived from GSO provincial GRDP sources
candidates.description: Meta-node binding Da Nang GRDP, Can Tho GRDP, Central Highlands regional profile, and selected secondary provincial economies into a coherent further-provincial densification layer that complements the earlier Hanoi, HCMC, Red River Delta, industrial-province and Mekong Delta nodes.

candidates.notes: Integrating node for the further provincial densification pass.
